    <h1>We measure extreme environmental events where people live and link them to health records at scale.</h1>
    <p class="lede">The Confluence Projects bring environmental data science together with clinical informatics and biostatistics at Massachusetts General Hospital, Harvard Medical School, and the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health. Our core resource, GridEX, delineates extreme heat and cold events on a 500&nbsp;m grid across the contiguous United States from 2008 to 2022.</p>

<section class="home-section column-page" aria-labelledby="what-we-study">
  <h2 id="what-we-study">What we study</h2>

  <div class="thread">
    <h3>Exposure where people live</h3>
    <div>
      <p>Studies of extreme heat and cold have long assigned each person the reading from the nearest weather station, which misclassifies who was exposed during an event. GridEX estimates daily apparent temperature, which accounts for humidity and wind, and traces the boundary of each extreme event as it moves. Because the output is gridded, it links to health data at any geographic scale.</p>
      <p><a href="gridex.html">How GridEX works</a></p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="thread">
    <h3>Extreme events in community health centers</h3>
    <div>
      <p>Through the Community CATALYST Center, we link GridEX to the shared electronic health record of OCHIN, a national network of community health centers. The first study from this linkage analyzed 4.2 million ambulatory encounters at 2,554 centers in 40 states and appeared in <em>JAMA Network Open</em> in September 2026.</p>
      <p><a href="posts/ochin_jama_netw_open_2026.html">Read about the study</a></p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="thread">
    <h3>Extreme events and aging</h3>
    <div>
      <p>Older adults carry a disproportionate share of the health burden from extreme heat and cold. With support from the National Institute on Aging, we use GridEX to study how these events relate to health and health care use in later life. In the community health center study, blood pressure fell further on extreme heat days in adults 65 and older than in younger adults.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="gridex-band column-page" aria-labelledby="gridex-data">
  <div class="band-text">
    <h2 id="gridex-data">GridEX is open data</h2>
    <p>GridEX catalogs extreme heat and cold events for the contiguous United States, with daily surfaces of temperature, dew point, wind speed, and apparent temperature. Raster layers come as GeoTIFF and event boundaries as GeoPackage, released under the MIT license. The method is described in <a href="https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.est.5c03658"><em>Environmental Science &amp; Technology</em> (2025)</a>.</p>
    <div class="facts">
      <div><span class="fact-n">500 m</span><span class="fact-l">grid resolution</span></div>
      <div><span class="fact-n">2008–2022</span><span class="fact-l">daily coverage</span></div>
      <div><span class="fact-n">~2,250</span><span class="fact-l">NOAA weather stations</span></div>
      <div><span class="fact-n">800M+</span><span class="fact-l">station records</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="home-actions">
      <a class="btn btn-ink" href="https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/DJGKDJ">Download from Dataverse</a>
      <a class="btn btn-line" href="https://ehce.connect.hms.harvard.edu/us_ehe_ece">Open the interactive catalog</a>
    </div>
  </div>

(function () {
  var v = document.getElementById('hero-video');
  var label = document.getElementById('hero-date');
  var btn = document.getElementById('hero-toggle');
  if (!v || !label || !btn) return;
  var frames = [
    'Extreme heat, 15 July 2022', 'Extreme heat, 16 July 2022', 'Extreme heat, 17 July 2022',
    'Extreme heat, 18 July 2022', 'Extreme heat, 19 July 2022',
    'Extreme cold, 21 December 2022', 'Extreme cold, 22 December 2022', 'Extreme cold, 23 December 2022',
    'Extreme cold, 24 December 2022', 'Extreme cold, 25 December 2022'
  ];
  var step = 1.4;
  function sync() {
    var i = Math.min(frames.length - 1, Math.floor(v.currentTime / step));
    if (label.textContent !== frames[i]) label.textContent = frames[i];
  }
  v.addEventListener('timeupdate', sync);
  function setPaused(p) {
    if (p) { v.pause(); btn.textContent = 'Play'; }
    else { var r = v.play(); if (r && r.catch) r.catch(function(){}); btn.textContent = 'Pause'; }
  }
  btn.addEventListener('click', function () { setPaused(!v.paused); });
  var rm = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  if (rm && rm.matches) {
    v.removeAttribute('autoplay'); setPaused(true);
    var others = document.querySelectorAll('.band-map video');
    for (var k = 0; k < others.length; k++) { others[k].removeAttribute('autoplay'); others[k].pause(); others[k].setAttribute('controls', ''); }
  }
})();
</script>
